name: Why does the sea cry so much?
source:
"That's a long story, young one, and not a happy one. Do you truly wish to know?"

The story follows Rosa, a young teen spending time in her family's beach house. One  night, she sees a mysterious lady in the sea. After approaching her to see if she was alright, she discovers the lady is a spirit that comes back to this beach from time to time. The spirit offers to tell her an old tale, and Rosa will discover this tale is more connected to her than she imagined.

This story was actually inspired by an old Brazilian fairy tale called "Porque o mar tanto chora" that translates to "Why does the sea cry so much?".

[From [url=https://wizard-of-ox.itch.io/why-does-the-sea-cry-so-much]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「說來話長，孩子，而且並不是個愉快的故事。你真的想知道嗎？」

故事圍繞Rosa展開。她是一名少女，正住在家裡的海邊別墅。某夜，她看見海中有位神秘女子。她上前想看看對方是否平安，才發現那女子是個幽靈，時不時會回到這片海灘。幽靈提出要講述一個古老的故事，而Rosa將發現，這個故事與她的關聯遠比想像中更深。

本作的靈感來自一則古老的巴西童話《Porque o mar tanto chora》，意為「海為何如此哭泣」。

[摘自[url=https://wizard-of-ox.itch.io/why-does-the-sea-cry-so-much]Itch.io[/url]]
